 The most flavor options on the island!Looking a sweet treat while in Gulf Shores, Alabama? Look no further, you found us! We proudly serve Blue Bell Premium Ice Cream. We have over 40 flavor options! We promise choosing a flavor of ice cream will be the hardest decision while at Island Ice Cream and Treats! Don't forget the toppings because we sure didn't! We have a large assortment of toppings, syrups and treats to top your ice cream off with. Island Ice Cream and Treats has been open since the summer of 2011 right across the street from the white sandy beaches in Gulf Shores, Alabama!  Whether you choose to dine in or carry out, we are here to fix any ice cream craving you have while vacationing on the Alabama Gulf Coast! Come see us today!

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 A Family Favorite!
 
 The best place for ice cream in Gulf Shores, Alabama!

 SPECIALTY SUNDAES!

 
 
 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 
 
 

 

 
 

 Whether you live in Gulf Shores or are vacationing, Island Ice Cream and Treats is the perfect place to get a sweet treat! Families from all over the country have stopping in and raved about how much they love all our unique flavors.

 Not only do we have over 40 flavor options, but we also can make sundaes and shakes out of any of them! We offer several sundaes that come in a souvenir jar for you to keep!The kids in your family will LOVE our Superman, Cotton Candy and Birthday Batter flavors and the adults may love them too! 

 View the full menu →

structuredData.description: Gulf Shores Ice Cream! The most flavor options on the beach! We have over 40 flavors of premium Hershey's Ice cream including Italian Ice, yogurt, sherbet and reduced fat options! Don't for get about the milk shakes, smoothies, sundaes and chocolates because we sure didn't! Find us in Gulf Shores Alabama this summer when you are in need of a tasty treat!
